quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on building championship habits for a new team
quotes.excerpt: We got to know everybody, tendency what they do on the court, off the court, hang out with each other.
quotes.quote: We got to know everybody first. We got to know everybody, tendency what they do on the court, off the court, hang out with each other. Like I said, just get to know each other, build that chemistry. I think that's the first thing that goes into building a championship team.

structured.context: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope discusses the process of building team chemistry and championship habits with his new teammates during a practice media availability.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on LeBron James' evolution as a team leader
quotes.excerpt: He's just more being that team leader, slowing the pace down, also just getting everybody in their same position.
quotes.quote: I think it helped the change. For him, it's just more being that team leader, slowing the pace down, also just getting everybody in their same position. I think he's still been LeBron, just doing it in a different way.

structured.context: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope reflects on how LeBron James has evolved his leadership style and approach to the game.

quotes.speaker: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
quotes.summary_phrase: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope on the team's selflessness and ball movement
quotes.excerpt: It's all our selfishness, our willingness to pass the ball, find the open guy.
quotes.quote: It's all our selfishness, our willingness to pass the ball, find the open guy. I think that's been the biggest emphasis for us, just hitting the open guy and just being able to play with each other.
